fix.summary: Review-005 is valid and current HEAD 122c263 has only preserved the review docket; none of the four source findings changed from target 05b29d9. Apply the four bounded dispositions below directly. No new Plan is authorized or needed: final authority already fixes the behavior, owners, red/green oracles, and unchanged scope. After a new HEAD supplies the stated production-seam verification, convergence is possible by Apply re-adjudication without another Plan.

classes.name: Navigator Soul layering
classes.owner: Navigator Soul owner under CLAUDE.md's owner-direct Soul revision channel
classes.boundary: souls/navigator.md only; preserve irreducible least-cost-safe-process judgment, advisory/nonbinding identity, failure honesty, and caller autonomy, while leaving active-tool and invocation mechanics to runtime/schema
classes.disposition: Accepted. The enumerated prohibition on calling roles, Agent, Runner, Recorder, shell, Git/GitHub, worktrees, and mutation is mechanical duplication already owned by createNavigatorRoleRuntime's tool gate. Remove that tool inventory and any equivalent implementation list; do not broaden or rewrite the profession. This Soul edit must use the repository's owner-direct channel rather than making the factory/Fixer the author. Verification: owner reviews the full Soul against CLAUDE.md's admission test, and the existing production Navigator runtime tests continue to prove the actual bounded-reader/output-tool gate and forbidden sibling capability boundary; do not add wording- or regex-anchored Soul tests.

classes.name: Assisted run locator UUIDv7 predicate
classes.owner: Assisted Runner run-locator boundary in src/assisted-runner.ts
classes.boundary: runIndex validation used by status, end, recovery, enter/resume lookup; UUID syntax remains owned once by src/uuidv7.ts
classes.disposition: Accepted. Replace the remaining inline canonical UUIDv7 regex with isUuidV7; add no second wrapper or parallel guard. Verification must traverse a public Assisted Runner locator operation and show a canonical UUIDv7 reaches normal lookup while uppercase, wrong-version, and malformed IDs fail as invalid locators, with the shared predicate itself covered and build/typecheck passing.

classes.name: Dense AssistedCall validator names
classes.boundary: local record/provenance/path variables inside validateAssistedCallConfigV1 only; no schema, validation, error-contract, or module-shape redesign
classes.disposition: Accepted as the concrete Mysterious Name smell, not elevated to a behavioral defect. Current one-letter s/g/a/e/p variables obscure subject, GitHub, acquisition, execution, path, and provenance roles, and p changes meanings. Rename the cited locals to domain-revealing names with the smallest readable reflow; do not add abstraction or duplicate validation. Verification: existing config boundary tests must remain green for closed shape, role/phase, path/workspace, evidence/provenance, label, environment, and child-set cases, plus typecheck; no new production mechanism is warranted.

classes.name: Tracker observation freshness digest
classes.owner: Navigator snapshot canonicalization contract in src/navigator-contracts.ts, consumed by the Assisted Runner freshness gate
classes.boundary: canonicalSnapshotDigestV1 and its contract/lifecycle regression coverage; normalize capturedAt only, not parentObservation.observedAt or child observedAt
classes.disposition: Accepted. Final authority separately lists snapshot capture time and tracker observation time, declares every tracker-observation change stale, and exempts only time alone; in context, that exemption is capture-time-only drift, not drift of typed tracker observedAt. Remove observedAt normalization for parent and children while retaining capturedAt normalization. Verification must prove: changing only capturedAt preserves the digest; changing parent observedAt changes it; changing any child observedAt changes it; old receipts no longer bind those changed observations; and a production Assisted Runner enter/resume freshness scenario with observation-time-only tracker drift reconsults before selected-role launch rather than reusing prior advice. Rebuild assisted distribution and run the relevant lifecycle/contracts tests, full test suite, and typecheck.

details.note: All four Review-005 findings are explicitly accepted on current evidence; none is dismissed. The repair surface is deletion/simplification plus one shared-predicate reuse, local renames, and correction of an existing canonicalization rule—no guardrail, parallel mechanism, owner choice, or Plan gate is justified. Soul authorship remains subject to CLAUDE.md's owner-direct exception; the direct Fixer Apply authority covers the three code classes and coordination of verification, not ownership of Soul prose.
